scripts.install:apps: npm ci --prefix client && npm ci --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently --names client,server --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server && npm run demo:lint
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run demo:typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix client && npm run test --prefix server && npm run demo:test
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix client && npm run test:coverage --prefix server
scripts.demo:lint: npm exec --prefix server -- eslint --config server/eslint.config.js db-seed/src
